sources: PSNProfiles — grades and PSN progress targets
meta.note: Official names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide is written for this entry in our own words and cites its sources.

note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide is this entry's own writing, built from the official description and citing its sources; where the description does not pin down a place or step, the guide says so instead of inventing one. Hidden flags follow the official list as frozen on 2026-11-18.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself — PlayStation asks for nothing else. Follow the roadmap stages in order and keep the checklist ticked as you play, so the platinum is never a mystery hunt at the end. When only a few trophies remain, sort the checklist by roadmap order and work the earliest unfinished stage first; the platinum lands with the last of them. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from its start to its end screen. It is the first story mission, so simply follow the opening beats until the mission-complete screen appears and the trophy fires. The description names no optional step, so there is nothing extra to hunt — just finish the mission. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play every mission of Chapter 1 through to the chapter's end. Chapter trophies fire when the chapter closes, not on any single mission, so keep pushing the story markers in order and finish each mission rather than wandering off mid-chapter. No side content is needed for it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 the same way: every mission in order until the chapter-end screen. The trophy belongs to the chapter, so a mission failed and retried still counts as long as the chapter itself is completed. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in full. Keep the story moving mission by mission; the trophy fires when the chapter closes. If a mission fails, retry it at once from the mission-failed screen rather than wandering off into free roam. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 in full — the last numbered chapter before the finale. Play its missions in order to the chapter-end screen, and the trophy fires with the chapter. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its end. This is the story's last mission, so finish the chapters before it, take the finale when the story offers it, and see it through to the end screen. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Take the Breakfast Run mission when the story offers it and play it to completion. Named-mission trophies fire on the mission-complete screen, so do not quit halfway — a failed mission can be retried from the fail screen. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in full. Heist missions are one-shot story beats: take the mission when it appears, play it through, and the trophy fires at the end. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. As with the other named missions, the trophy fires on completion, so play it through in one run where you can. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission from start to finish. The description ties the trophy to that one mission alone, so nothing else in the game matters for it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Play it through to the mission-complete screen; the trophy is the mission's, not the chapter's. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Take the mission when the story offers it and finish it — the trophy fires on the mission-complete screen. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion counter: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the rest, all finished. The counter is the authority — open the in-game completion screen to see what is still missing, then work the roadmap's later stages until it reads 100%. This is the long grind of the set, so leave it for stage 2 after the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Rack up 250 stunts as the game counts them: jumps, near-misses and airtime. Take them as you drive through the story and free roam rather than grinding them all at once — every stunt counts toward the total whenever it happens. The description gives no breakdown of stunt types, so any stunt the game counts moves the total. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once: races, the range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, hunting, meditation and the rest. The trophy asks for breadth, not mastery — one try at each is enough. Open the activities list in-game to see which types you have not tried yet. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work the challenge list one weapon at a time and replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until it turns gold. This is the hardest activity trophy in the set — take it in short sessions and learn each challenge's rhythm before chasing the gold time. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location the game offers. Learn each course on a practice run first, then race to win — the description does not list how many locations there are, so use the in-game race list to see which ones are still unwon. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different race events — twenty distinct races, not the same race twenty times. Work through the race list across Leonida and tick each new win off; a repeat win on a race you already won adds nothing. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Learn the fishing rhythm on a quiet cast first — hook, reel and timing — then take the challenge against Cal. The description names no location, so take the challenge wherever the game offers it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to end. Pick the cabinet game you are best at and play it through — a half-finished run does not count. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's stranger strand to its final mission and complete it. Strands unlock across the story, so keep checking for Andy's missions as you play, and finish the strand before the endgame. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's stranger strand to its final mission and complete it. Take his missions whenever they appear as the story moves on, and finish the strand before the endgame — a strand left half-done stalls the Strangers & Freaks silver. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's stranger strand to its final mission and complete it. His strand is one of the eight the Strangers & Freaks trophy counts, so keep his missions moving whenever his marker shows. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete all eight stranger strands. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more — play each strand to its final mission. A strand left half-done stalls this silver, so track all eight in the reference and finish each one before the endgame. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's stranger strand to its final mission and complete it. Take his missions as they appear and play the strand to its end — the trophy fires on that final mission. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's stranger strand to its final mission and complete it. Follow his marker whenever it appears and play the strand through to its last mission — finish it when it is offered rather than parking the strand. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot in Leonida. The description gives no count, so use the in-game map markers to find each spot and tick it off as you visit. Pair the visits with the full-map sweep so one road trip covers both. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Take the hunt slowly — track the animal rather than rushing it — and finish the hunt the game asks for. The description names no animal or place, so follow Bret's strand and the in-game markers. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards hide around Leonida — work one set at a time and check the collection menu to see which cards are still missing from each set. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. A pure exploration count — pair it with the full-map sweep and the vehicle count, one long road trip covering all three. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind: driving, shooting, exploration and more. Pick the easy ones first — fifty is a fraction of what the game offers, so the list fills up fast once you start trying things. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. Build the wanted level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and get clear — the trophy fires when the heat is gone. Do it while you are passing, not after the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them. Plan a route past three shops, hit them in sequence, and do not lose the heat — if the wanted level drops, the streak breaks and you start again. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride each one and the game logs it — try every car, bike, boat and truck you pass. Pair it with the map sweep and the WAiNK It count on one long road trip. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Set the attempt up first — gather enemies in one spot, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. A kill outside the window does not count. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. The description ties it to a single moment at VCIA — when the chance comes, take it; the moment does not wait. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not a checklist — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points at the Rhino tank without spelling out the ask. The in-game trophy hint is the authority here; this guide says so rather than inventing a step the description does not pin down. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm — and get out clean. If you are spotted, leave and try again. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway before the robbery, with a fast car waiting — the escape counts as much as the robbery. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Watch for trucks on their routes in free roam and hit one when the moment is right — then get clear before the heat closes in. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every corner of Leonida. Drive every road and visit every region — the in-game map shows what is still blank, so sweep region by region until nothing is left unexplored. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. The description does not list the gangs, so use the in-game map and markers to find each gang's operation and work through them one at a time. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description ties this trophy to a single early moment — take it when the game offers it, while you are on Ocean Beach. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. A single showroom moment — go in, cause the chaos the description asks for, and get out through the glass. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a full game there. It is also a missable moment, so play the game while you are passing the alley rather than saving it for after the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — 'a partnership with mass appeal' names no place, person or step. The in-game trophy hint is the authority here; this guide does not invent a step the official description does not pin down. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make the story choices the description points at. 'Choices made (for better or worse)' ties the trophy to a decision point in the story — play the mission where the choice is offered and make the call. The description does not say which choice, so follow the story and take the decision when it comes. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A moment that only comes around twice — if the first attempt goes wrong, the retry is the trophy. The description names no place or step, so keep an eye out in free roam and take the second chance when it appears. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A strange event in free roam — the description names no place or time, so keep an eye out while you explore Leonida and take the event when it finds you. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock the pins down from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Line the shot up on the approach and swing as you pass. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — hand them to your contacts to clean them, in small regular batches, until the total reaches $250,000. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, anything the shops sell. Buy what you actually use and the total climbs on its own; a big purchase late on closes the gap fast. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property. Save up and buy garages as they appear on the property market — keep a cash reserve, because the last garages are the expensive ones. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app and register ten different vehicles — the ones you drive anyway. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
